name: Hall of Thanes
summary: Alliance defenders now seek a way into the Hall of Thanes, deep beneath Ironforge. Its old vaults hold dwarven relics, and danger has reached those depths.

sections.title: Secrets Beneath the Mountain
sections.body: Hammers ring in Ironforge's Great Forge, but forgotten halls run deeper beneath the stone. The Hall of Thanes lies in those ancient reaches, tied to dwarven bloodlines and relics of stonecraft. Now Alliance champions must enter its shadowed vaults and guard the depths.

sections.title: Uncovering the Path
sections.body: The route into the Hall of Thanes is hidden from Ironforge's everyday travelers. Its corridors have been sealed or concealed. To find a way through, recover an Underground Map and use forgotten charts to navigate the deeper tunnels to the entrance.

sections.title: The Threat of Dirgehammer
sections.body: Durgen Dirgehammer commands the inner sanctuary of the Hall of Thanes. Plunder, an enchanted guardian, and the fiery brute Magmatus threaten its halls. Faldrim Anvilmar comes from an ancient dwarven lineage. Defeating Durgen ends the unrest beneath the city and protects the sacred halls from subversion.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Thanes located?
faq.answer: The Hall of Thanes lies beneath Ironforge, in the mountain's deeper, restricted passages, away from the main city thoroughfares.

faq.q: How do I gain access to the Hall of Thanes?
aliases: how to get into hall of thanes
faq.answer: Earthseer Farsen watches Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh and begins the route. Recover the Underground Map, then follow Old Ironforge Incursion into the Hall of Thanes.

faq.q: What bosses are inside the Hall of Thanes?
faq.answer: Four major threats await inside: Faldrim Anvilmar, Magmatus, the enchanted golem Plunder, and Durgen Dirgehammer.

faq.q: What level range is recommended for this dungeon?
aliases: what level is hall of thanes
faq.answer: The Hall of Thanes is built for Alliance adventurers between levels 13 and 18, an early challenge deep beneath Ironforge.

faq.q: Can Horde players enter the Hall of Thanes?
aliases: can horde do hall of thanes
is hall of thanes alliance only
faq.answer: No. The Hall of Thanes is for the Alliance and lies beneath their capital, Ironforge.

faq.q: What does defeating Durgen Dirgehammer achieve?
faq.answer: Defeating Durgen Dirgehammer breaks the hold of rogue dwarven forces and their summoned constructs beneath Ironforge. The ancestral vaults below the Great Forge are safe again.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you enter Dun Morogh's ancestral bedrock and drive defilers from sacred halls bearing legendary clan names.
As an Alliance member, you help protect Ironforge's stability by clearing deep caverns and securing the High Seat.
As a gnome living alongside your close allies in Ironforge, you have reason to help stop mechanical constructs like Plunder from threatening your shared refuge.
